# Release Rule

## Summary
When a module becomes visible to a cohort: on start, N days after start, on a fixed date, or manually. A plan, not an event — the release itself is recorded on the Cohort by Release Module.

## Usage
`@field releaseRule = contains(ReleaseRuleField);` on Module. `plannedReleaseDate(rule, cohortStart)` gives the timeline mark.

## Non-goals
Does not release anything; does not know about learners.
